statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ (p a : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p≠2 → ((roots a p).card : ℤ) = 1 + legendreSym p (-(a : ℤ))
